reviews.text: We were very happy with Luri, we had complete confidence in them throughout our trip, with daily and very thorough updates! I highly recommend them, it was perfect 🫶🏼

Luri and Manu cared for our kitten for two weeks, and the experience was excellent. They were attentive to all her needs down to the smallest detail and kept us informed at all times, documenting each visit with photos and updates. Thanks to them, we were able to relax and feel close to our kitten even when we were far away. We definitely recommend them and will trust them again.

Simply EXCELLENT. Lury looked after my daughter's and my cats, Kipo and Noly, during our vacation. It's such a relief knowing they're in her hands. She keeps you updated on everything and sends photos and videos of the kittens and their meals. I highly recommend her. We'll definitely be using Lury again whenever we need her.

She looked after my cat Kipo for a week. She was a wonderful person. Every day she sent videos of how the kitty was doing, explaining what she was doing, what she had eaten, and how often she went to the bathroom... I could see the cat was very happy. I recommend her 100%.
We were delighted, both us and our kitties! Luri is lovely and super affectionate. Juno and Thai had a wonderful time. We'll definitely be back on future trips!

Everything was excellent. Communication with us was very smooth, and we always felt at ease. We loved the care and dedication she showed to the children. We would definitely use this service again. We have complete confidence in Luri.

We couldn't be happier with Luri and Manuel. They've already cared for our two cats twice, and the experience has been excellent from the very beginning.

Communication has always been smooth and friendly, keeping us informed at all times with messages, photos, videos, and updates that provide immense peace of mind.

What we value most is the respect and sensitivity with which they've treated our little ones. Each has a completely different personality: one is calmer and more observant, while the other is young, very playful, and full of energy. They've perfectly understood each cat's needs, adapting to their rhythms and always respecting their pace and space, never forcing any interaction.

They've earned our complete trust, and that's priceless. Knowing we can be away from home with the peace of mind that our cats are well cared for is a true relief.

We're incredibly lucky to have found them. We will certainly continue to rely on them whenever we need them.

Luri is an excellent caregiver. My four cats were very well cared for, looked after, and stimulated during their visits. She's completely trustworthy and we communicated very well before, during, and after the cat sitting service. I will definitely use her again. 100% recommended.

**** MAY 26 We used Luri's services again and, as always, she was fantastic. You can tell she loves cats, understands them, and knows them well. She gives you all the information in real time and is incredibly attentive to everyone. She's completely trustworthy and highly recommended. And what can I say about my cats? All five of them are in love with Luri! **** JANUARY 26 Luri took care of my five kittens for a few days. Each one has their own needs and personality, and Luri won them all over! She adapts to the family's needs, is affectionate, serious, and responsible, and above all, you can tell she adores cats. She keeps you informed at all times about how they are, how they play, how they eat, and how they use the litter box. In short, a 10 out of 10 in every way! We'll definitely use her again!

I was delighted with how Luri treated my cats. She cared for them as if they were her own, and I felt very relaxed during the trip. She was always attentive to their mood and physical condition and kept me perfectly informed. Thank you so much!

Mushu and Stitch couldn't have been better cared for!

We'll definitely be using Luri again 😊

Our kittens had a fantastic time playing with her, and it also gave us peace of mind knowing that if anything happened to them while we weren't home, she was always there for them.

We're so happy to have found her. She's given us incredible peace of mind, taking care of all three of us, especially little Runa, who's been feeling a bit under the weather.

We'll definitely be back to her 💕

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Nieve, Trufa, and Runa! 🩵🐾🫂

This wonderful person has been taking care of my cat for over 7 days. My kitten is quite timid and doesn't like being around strangers. However, from the very first minute, she had a fantastic time with Karen. She's a true professional! We felt very comfortable and relaxed because she kept us updated in real time on how my cat was doing. I recommend her without a doubt! Don't hesitate, because your kittens will be incredibly well cared for by her ❤️❤️😻

Highly recommend! Very responsible, respectful, and loving care. You can see the dedication and affection she puts into her work. She gave me lots of advice on improving my cat's lifestyle, and communication was excellent throughout.

Our cats have been cared for by Luri for 7 days. We couldn't be happier with her. She treated the cats exceptionally well, was loving, attentive, and reliable. Every day she sent us videos and a report on how the cats were doing. In short, an excellent professional and an even better person. Our cats couldn't have been better cared for. Thank you for everything, Luri.

Karen Poppets took care of my cat Gizmo, and she was truly wonderful. It's clear she loves cats and treated him with so much care. Gizmo was calm, and I felt so comfortable knowing he was in good hands. I would choose her again without hesitation.

Entrusting my cat Noa to Karen Poppets was the best decision I made. She inspired confidence from the very beginning and kept me informed every step of the way. Noa was happy and calm, and that's priceless to me. I highly recommend her.

Luri is the best ❤️. I have four cats and she takes care of them with incredible love. She always sends me tons of photos and videos; you can tell she really enjoys being with them, and I feel so much more at ease when I travel because I know they're in good hands. My cats adore her.

Meeting Luri has changed us so much for the better, and not just us, but also our furry friend. From day one, she has been respectful and incredibly loving. She has guided and supported us through a very emotionally difficult time. Finding out about Trece's illness was tough, but going through it together has been such a relief 🙏🏼 We can say with complete peace of mind and certainty that we would recommend her magnificent work without hesitation!
She dedicates her time to playing, giving Trece a great brain workout, giving him his well-deserved treats and cuddles, and his all-important medication. She also keeps us updated with videos and photos so we cat parents can have peace of mind and enjoy a few getaways 😉
We want to give a special mention to Manu for his dedication, excellent attitude, and his natural talent with cats!
Thank you Luri and Manu for your professionalism and especially for your care towards Visi and Eme. I was able to enjoy my vacation peacefully because they were in the best hands!

My partner and I are absolutely delighted with Luri's services and her backup cat sitter, Manuel. We couldn't have been more relaxed on our vacation. It's the first time we've used this service, and we'll definitely be back. Both our cat, Juanita, and we enjoyed our vacation so much more this way, avoiding unnecessary stress for our beloved pet. It's a completely professional and trustworthy service.

P.S. Plus, Luri takes amazing photos!

Knowing that Luri is taking care of our cat has given us so much peace of mind. We've used her several times and will definitely do so again. Our cat adores her, and we adore her even more. Thank you for everything.
Luri is fantastic. My four cats have been happy and calm with her. We will definitely be back.

Luri was wonderful with our cats. She took excellent care of them while my husband and I were away. It's the first time we've had someone look after our cats, and we have complete confidence in Luri. She is kind and gentle with cats and puts owners at ease. One of our two cats is shy, but Luri won him over completely. Our second cat played a lot and enjoyed Luri's company. We speak little Spanish, but this hasn't been a barrier at all; Luri is understanding, patient, and can speak English if needed. We wholeheartedly recommend Luri, and we now have peace of mind knowing we have someone we can trust in Madrid with our precious cats.

Luri is simply the best. Our cat Cati is very wary and easily frightened, and Luri came several times before we left on our trip to groom her—a brilliant idea, as Cati came out to greet her every single day. We couldn't be more at ease with her. A 10 out of 10!

It's been a pleasure leaving our cats Troya and Abeto in Luri's care. Everything has gone wonderfully, and she's been very professional and caring, sending us videos and photos every day and keeping us updated on the kitties' well-being. Thanks to her, we were able to enjoy a relaxing vacation. You can tell she cares deeply for the cats and treated them wonderfully. She has a real way with them, both with Abeto, who is very sociable, and Troya, who is a bit more reserved with strangers, but was very comfortable with Luri. Thank you so much for everything; we'll definitely be back! 🥰🥰🥰

If you ever need someone to look after your cats, Luri is undoubtedly the best choice. Affectionate, attentive, and very knowledgeable about feline behavior, she's especially genuinely interested before, during, and after each visit. My cat Frida couldn't have been in better hands while I was away. Luri keeps you updated throughout the visit and sends videos to show how happy they are with her. I'll definitely use her again.

I leave my cats in her care with the peace of mind that comes from knowing they'll be even better off than with me. The love and attention she gives them is incredible, and she quickly earns their trust.
As for the process itself, she makes it incredibly easy to schedule a visit and leave the keys with her. On visiting days, she keeps me updated and sends photos and videos of my kitties so I can see they're doing great.

Furthermore, if she ever finds anything that could be dangerous for them, she takes care of it and lets me know so I can fix it. I can only thank her because I know that if I ever have to leave them alone, I'll always have someone to turn to without hesitation.
It was such a stroke of luck finding Luri! She was so careful with our cat while we were on vacation. We'll definitely call her again! And thanks for Forchetta's new favorite game!

It's wonderful to have Luri take care of Selma and Pati. She's given us so much peace of mind, confidence, professionalism, and above all, so much love and care for our cats. Having her means knowing they'll be in the best hands.
We've been so lucky to meet her! We'll definitely be back! 😻 …
